name: omnimail
description: A small, self-hosted webmail deployed as one Cloudflare Worker with Static Assets, D1, R2, Queues, and Resend.

SETUP_TOKEN.description: Required one-time token for creating the first super administrator. Use at least 32 random characters and remove it after setup.

SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Required email address of the super administrator, for example owner@example.com.

ICLOUD_CREDENTIALS_KEY.description: Optional. At least 32 random UTF-8 bytes for encrypting iCloud cookies and app-specific passwords.

LINUX_DO_MAIL_CREDENTIALS_KEY.description: Optional. At least 32 random UTF-8 bytes for encrypting Linux DO Mail passwords or authentication tokens.

GMAIL_CREDENTIALS_KEY.description: Optional. At least 32 random UTF-8 bytes for encrypting Gmail app passwords.

QQ_MAIL_CREDENTIALS_KEY.description: Optional. At least 32 random UTF-8 bytes for encrypting QQ Mail authorization codes.

NAVER_MAIL_CREDENTIALS_KEY.description: Optional. At least 32 random UTF-8 bytes for encrypting NAVER Mail app-specific passwords.

MICROSOFT_CREDENTIALS_KEY.description: Optional. At least 32 random UTF-8 bytes for encrypting Microsoft OAuth tokens and optional combination passwords.

scripts.check: npm run check:lines && npm run lint && tsc --noEmit --pretty false && tsc -p email-worker/tsconfig.json --noEmit --pretty false && tsc -p email-worker/tsconfig.integration.json --noEmit --pretty false
